evidence: Exact origin/develop build failed 5/5 new real-SQLite tests: context list poison reached legacy getConversation; both detail tables and store APIs were absent; rollback hooks were unavailable. Failures were expected baseline behavior, not import/build errors.

Added two idempotent message-keyed detail tables with message/conversation ON DELETE CASCADE and conversation cursor indexes. Existing databases create empty tables only; historical metadata is not backfilled or rewritten.

createMessageTransaction and new updateMessageTransaction atomically persist message plus snapshot/model-usage details. Metadata stays complete. Retention keeps first plus latest 63 original sequences and full aggregate counters; table-first reads fall back to legacy metadata.

Read-only implementation audit identified repeated lifecycle rewrites of the same large immutable snapshot. Added a message_id+snapshot_id current-row probe before summary/JSON serialization so streaming/tool/completed updates skip identical snapshot UPSERTs while model usage remains transactional.

Context snapshot list now uses a single chat_messages-driven descending cursor query, default 50 and max 100, with opaque conversation-bound cursors and pageInfo. Mixed table/metadata rows share one order and the controller no longer hydrates full conversations.

Final persisted 15,052-message synthetic gate with 379.4MiB metadata and 120 legacy object snapshots passed. Existing idx_chat_messages_conversation_id drove the page query. A 247.4KiB snapshot drove dual writes; duration 330.8ms, heap/RSS deltas 19.0/20.5MiB, retained heap +7.5MiB, database +4.6MiB, historical metadata bytes unchanged, forbidden hydration zero, integrity ok, foreign keys clean.

A private git-archive build of exact pre-P2C origin/develop@31dca4f2 opened an Expand-created SQLite fixture, read full snapshot/modelUsage metadata, updated the message, and ignored extra tables. Reopening with Expand preserved table-first detail reads and integrity.
